messages.subject: Error while using ifelse
parts:
Hi Team,

getting error while running below code

ifelse ( (function() get_attribute(env, "restorage") ) == 0  ,
#ifelse ( in_cr1$Crane.No  == 0  ,
 seize("conveyor_cart", 1) %>%
 log_("Got Conveyor cart") %>%
 timeout(ST4_ST2) %>%
 release("conveyor_cart", 1) %>%
 log_("CR1_Transliner movement Completed. Right now at Truck loading Area") ,

seize("conveyor_cart", 1) %>%
  log_("Got Conveyor cart and moving to manual picking area") %>%
  timeout(ST4_ST13) %>%
  release("conveyor_cart", 1) 

)



Error message mentioned below
"
Error in ifelse(., (function() get_attribute(env, "restorage")) == 0,  : 
  unused argument (seize("conveyor_cart", 1) %>% log_("Got Conveyor cart and moving to manual picking area") %>% timeout(ST4_ST13) %>% release("conveyor_cart", 1)

Without ifelse code is working fine. Please correct me if I am missing anything here.
